findings: Both timed sides call identical Harness.execute: same-topology update, original F1/F2 upload, checked native completion, owning output return/release. Cold snapshots and decoding are outside the warm interval and separately charged.

Both sides share compute_batch staging/upload/wait and paged lease admission. Native reference additionally compares all four layout arrays twice and validates pinned FP8 frame identity; candidate update compares only q/kv indptr. No missing candidate-only lifecycle toll was established.

Both merge host paths query device/SM/occupancy and set shared-memory attribute. CE28 current codegen/runtime already proves the intended F32 merge and selected attention identities. Old CE27 timing cannot quantify remaining CE28 kernel cost.

Current attempt14 has all eight prefill medians inside 5-percent latency limit; two corrected CIs straddle1/1.05. UNRESOLVED/LOSS does not demonstrate a new material regression or authorize another vendor rewrite.

Independent G06 source gaps remain: capacity-sized immutable snapshot allocation/zero-fill, unconditional full metadata upload/wait, Graph sharing after each node has already uploaded, ordinary lease admission quadratic in page guards.

Reducing common lifecycle overhead on BOTH sides does not mathematically guarantee a better candidate/peer ratio and can expose a larger kernel ratio. G06 is admitted for its actual consumer complexity, not as a claimed cure for unresolved CUDA P1.
Full lease identity is LeaseAccess.identity(block) with generation while retained; LeaseBackingInfo.identity is shared by different pool blocks and MUST NOT be used for permission deduplication.

decision.cuda: Stop same-candidate P1, n63, profile/tile/threshold searches. Preserve all prior failures/costs. FI finite engineering gate remains INCONCLUSIVE and module BLOCKED, not CLOSED.
decision.scheduling: Goal remains ACTIVE. Explicitly permit already-scoped G06 intake before G04/G05 aggregate acceptance; no G item removed and no old gate promoted. Common and Graph owners may resume through BLOCKED->SCOPED on a separate G06 card.
decision.implementation: No new product FIX authorized in this checkpoint. G06 needs its own frozen architecture/API/finite FIX and AUDITED owners before implementation.

limits: Read-only source/cost audit, not a new runtime or throughput verdict.

Exploratory command failure: initial archive member lookup required a leading slash; corrected exact member lookup succeeded and original archive SHAs matched. No build, profile, model or server started.
No overall audit stopwatch was captured; this investigation elapsed cost is UNKNOWN, not zero. Prior run elapsed remains in attempt14 receipt.
